Personal notes on Chip Huyen's *Designing Machine Learning Systems* (O'Reilly, First Edition, 2022), written to prepare for machine learning interviews. Each chapter of this book covers one chapter of Huyen's book. A chapter can have a practice page of interview-style questions with collapsed worked answers.

| Chapter | Topic |
|---|---|
| 1 | Overview of Machine Learning Systems |
| 2 | Introduction to Machine Learning Systems Design |
| 3 | Data Engineering Fundamentals |
| 4 | Training Data |
| 5 | Feature Engineering |
| 6 | Model Development and Offline Evaluation |
| 7 | Model Deployment and Prediction Service |
| 8 | Data Distribution Shifts and Monitoring |
| 9 | Continual Learning and Test in Production |
| 10 | Infrastructure and Tooling for MLOps |
| 11 | The Human Side of Machine Learning |

Chapter numbers match the book's First Edition. A cumulative glossary is at the end.
